write_up: You’re a recent Ohio State computer science graduate with a Cardinal Health software engineering internship, help desk experience, and several application projects. It’s common for an early-career resume to lean on duties and team activities, but the internship needs more of the features and fixes you worked on to stand out for Software Engineer roles.

The Personal Finance Tracker line is a good model: it names the application, what it does, and the tools you used. Your education leads the resume, though you also have more than a year of work experience to put first.
Let’s start with the Cardinal Health role. Name an inventory feature you developed, then add what your tests checked and which bugs you fixed. Keep the project work that already shows what you built.
